summary.text: Clint Hostetler is a Republican Idaho state representative who has represented District 24A since December 2024 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A graphic designer, he succeeded Chenele Dixon in the seat.

paragraphs.text: Clint Hostetler was born in Fairfield, California, graduated from Dixon High School, and earned a bachelor's degree from California State University, Sacramento, in 2007.
His career experience includes working as a graphic designer.
He assumed office in the Idaho House of Representatives on December 1, 2024, and advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Hostetler described himself as a Christian conservative, husband, father and small business owner who supports family values, constitutional liberties, a smaller and more accountable government, lower taxes and free market principles.
He listed the First Amendment, the Tenth Amendment and family values and protecting children as his three key campaign messages.
